result.title: Certified Behavioral Retention for Continual Adaptation with Held-Out Anchors
result.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4M / CL4FMAgents)
result.summary: Continual adaptation requires deciding not only how to update a model, but whether to commit an update without exceeding a declared budget for changes to protected behavior. We introduce Certified Anchor-Based Adaptation (CABA), a candidate-agnostic post-update gate that reserves historical observations from candidate optimization, compares old and candidate policies on frozen representations, and selects the largest tested interpolation coefficient whose worst-anchor forward KL divergence remains within budget. The finite check requires neither action labels nor complete trajectories. We develop a theory-led certification framework that separates measured anchor retention from conditional off-anchor guarantees. Under explicit representation-coverage and Lipschitz assumptions, an accepted update satisfies a uniform behavioral-divergence bound on protected support. The analysis gives regularity bounds for affine softmax heads, probabilistic coverage and compression guarantees, interpolation monotonicity conditions, grid-resolution bounds, and trajectory-level and sequential-composition guarantees. In a controlled UCI Human Activity Recognition study used as a non-stationary sensor-policy proxy, CABA reduces mean forgetting from 1.01 percent for unconstrained adaptation to 0.00 percent at budget epsilon = 0.05, while reducing final average accuracy from 93.04 percent to 88.48 percent. The experiment illustrates a retention-plasticity trade-off and does not establish foundation-model or robotic performance. CABA provides an auditable retention check for candidate generators exposing comparable policy distributions and a declared update path, while deployment also requires separate evidence of current-task utility.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CABA：一种与候选生成器无关的更新后门控，保留历史观测作为冻结锚点，在旧策略与候选策略间选取满足最差锚点前向 KL 预算的最大插值系数，并给出覆盖与 Lipschitz 假设下的行为散度界及 UCI HAR 上的保持—可塑性权衡实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「锚点集合 + KL 预算 + 插值单调性」的提交/停止判据，可能为持续适配推理策略时限制内部或 latent 表示漂移提供可核查的借鉴线索，但论文不含视觉或多模态推理，也未验证 latent 推理收益。
